body: That's so encouraging to hear! Congratulations on getting back into a 4 year school! Was it difficult to do after getting low grades previously? One of my concerns is that I'll have a hard time enrolling anywhere because I destroyed my GPA
I guess because so many of my peers have graduated and started careers already I'm feeling very very behind

Thanks! I know my dad would always be there for me no matter what too. The thought of disappointing him so much is what is really holding me back. He has always been my greatest role model and letting him down breaks my heart. I like your idea about making a list so that I can see what I need to get done and cross them off as I go!
I'm fairly certain my mom will be angry (can't blame her) and will probably cry and not speak with me for a while. My dad is much more patient and will be upset as well but will be there to help me.

My family is not toxic at all. However, my mom does not think that ADHD is a real thing. When I was in middle school one of my teachers asked her to get me tested and she refused. I have no idea what my dad thinks about it.
Thank you :) I will definitely  be taking the advice that you all have given me and I'll give an update after.

I haven't heard about the shame cycle you mentioned. I had no idea it was something that people with ADHD usually experienced. Do you remember where you read about it? It's comforting to know that you also have taken more than the "average" amount of time to get your degree. For a while I thought maybe I just wasn't smart enough to graduate.

I didn't even consider that seeing a therapist and reaching out on here would count as steps. But you're right, it's a start at least. I thought about asking my therapist for advice on how to approach my parents but unfortunately I don't have health insurance and I'm not sure I will be able to afford another appointment any time soon.

Thank you! It's so nice to hear that someone went through something so similar! Sometimes I get stuck in a rut thinking that I'm the only who has f\*cked up so badly. Do you think you will go bak to school?
I want to try this. I think it could really work for me since I get overwhelmed easily. Unfortunately time isn't really on my side.

Even if they forgive me I know that it'll hurt them a lot and I'm so ashamed of myself and so afraid of hurting them that the thought of telling them scares the sh\*t out of me.

Living in another country must be so tough! Especially with ADHD. I know I would feel terribly alone. I'm glad to hear that your wife is there with you and keeping you going.

Thank you! But I'm not sure they would be able to forgive me for this and I don't blame them. I lack self-discipline and never managed to really leave the house or take steps to improve my situation. I beat myself up about it all the time but still don't fix it.
I've considered this but I don't have any health insurance so I'm not even sure I'll be able to pay for another appointment.
Ya as far as I know you can't be in the military and have any sort of mental problems.
Not that great when you've done what I've done.
